nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of CoCH
nodes.procedure: In a typical experiment, Co(NO3)2·6H2O (0.87 g), CO(NH2)2 (0.9 g), NH4F (0.22 g) and deionized water (80 mL) were mixed to form a uniform solution. The solution and the clean carbon fiber paper (CFP, 3×6 cm²) were placed in an autoclave, and heated at 120°C for 7 h. The resultant sample was ultrasonically washed with ultrapure water and ethanol, and then dried at 80°C under ambient atmosphere.

nodes.name: TiO2 coating by ALD
nodes.procedure: The deposition of TiO2 on CoCH was carried out by atomic layer deposition (ALD) in a PICOSUN SUNALE R-200 at 348 K. The TiCl4 and H2O were adopted as deposition precursors. During the ALD, the carrier gas (N2) flow is 120 sccm, the pulse time of 0.2 s, and the purge time is 18 s. The thickness of TiO2 coating was modulated by cycle numbers of ALD (25 cycles for main sample).

nodes.evidence_snippet: The formation of CoCH was verified by X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns (Fig. 1a). The XRD pattern matches well with that of Co(CO3)0.5(OH)·0.11H2O (JCPDS No. 48-0083)...

nodes.characterization_summary: Amorphous TiO2 shows no peaks 200-1200 cm⁻¹. CoCH: Co-O at 656 cm⁻¹. TiO2@CoCH: peak shifts to 684 cm⁻¹. TiO2@CoCH(A): OH⁻ at 1056 cm⁻¹ (Co(OH)2), no pristine CoCH peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the spectrum of the CoCH the small peaks below 600 cm⁻¹ are attributed to lattice vibrations, and the peak at 656 cm⁻¹ can be assigned to Co-O bond... After electrochemical measurement, a small peak at 1056 cm⁻¹ presences in the Raman spectrum of TiO2@CoCH(A).
